# Reader fixtures

All sample content is original to Koko and generated by `node tests/reader-fixtures.mjs` from the client directory. No external books or comic pages are redistributed.

The EPUB has two chapters, a unique search phrase, and deliberately hostile script/event attributes for browser sanitization checks. The PDF has two selectable text pages. The comic ZIP intentionally inserts pages in the order 10, 2, 1 plus a hidden macOS metadata entry. The FictionBook and text files exercise alternative reflowable formats.

Browser checks: open each format, navigate, search for `lantern` where present, add a bookmark, close/reopen, change font size, and check resume. The comic must show pages 1, 2, 10. Verify that executable EPUB markup is removed before loading; some embedded browsers block blob document frames, so EPUB pagination also needs testing in a full browser.
